notes:
Renames the previous Senderstatus prüfen entry to Settings and adds the dedicated Settings thumbnail.

Adds a new Settings dialog with a persistent playlist folder selector plus Create Playlist, Update Playlist and Senderstatus prüfen actions.

Create Playlist currently collects all discoverable channels from Adult-TV-Channels.com and OXAX.tv into Adult TV Test.m3u using stable Cumination plugin links instead of temporary stream URLs.

Update Playlist refreshes an existing Adult TV Test playlist, detects added, removed or changed channels, avoids duplicate entries and leaves the file untouched when nothing has changed.

The existing Senderstatus prüfen site-selection workflow is preserved and now launches from Settings; the Settings window closes completely when a status check is started.

Streaming, thumbnail, Landscape Wall and self-update logic remain unchanged from v1.85.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
